title: Bounded cached scalar string in linked TABLECONTENT cell

scope.operation: Write one cached scalar content in a linked-data cell inside a rectangular TABLECONTENT grid.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1032 table: one linked cell carrying one cached string, three scalar string cells, and one DATALINK; ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.97.3: linked-target fields are conditional on the linked flag, followed by the cell-content count and content sequence.
limits: One linked cell and one cached scalar string in the generated profile
No linked-cell block references, attributes, geometry, formatting, or multiple cached contents
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no native application semantics or DWG encoding claim.

implementation: Classify the table shape before applying the legacy single-cell content checks; the multi-cell path now reaches its own complete grid validator.
Allow a linked grid cell to carry the already-supported scalar content profile while retaining DATALINK handle validation and graph-closure preflight.
Emit linked metadata and the unconditional group 95 content count/list independently.

physical_wire: The linked cell emits 92=1, remapped 340=0x1710, 93=2, 94=3, 96=-5 and 95=1.
The linked cell's content sequence emits scalar type 1, the VALUE marker and the exact cached string cached-north-west.
One DATALINK record is emitted at 0x1710; all four cell content counts and linked flags are checked.
evidence.typed_readback: The TABLECONTENT handle is 0x15A0; the linked cell points to DATALINK 0x1710, retains row/column metadata 2/3 and unknown value -5, and reads back the cached string with data type 4. Scalar peer values remain present.
evidence.failure_control: Changing the linked-cell target to absent handle 0x799 is refused; an existing destination sentinel and the caller's changed source model remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the valid source target lets the same adapter export again; the linked graph and cached string read back intact.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
This receipt does not qualify multiple linked cells, multiple cached contents, other cached value types, broader DATALINK semantics, native TABLE rendering, or DWG output.
